rows.quote: We used summary results from GWAS published by (i) Sun and colleagues (19) on up to 2,922 plasma proteins measured with the Olink Explore 3072 platform in a subcohort of 52,363 UK Biobank participants of European ancestry; (ii) Ferkingstad and colleagues (6) on up to 4,907 aptamers for 4,719 plasma proteins measured with the SomaScan multiplex aptamer assay (version 4) in 35,559 Icelanders from deCODE; (iii) O’Mara and colleagues (20) on endometrial cancer (12,270 cases and 46,126 controls), endometrioid cancer subtype (8,758 cases and 46,126 controls), and nonendometrioid cancer subtype (1,230 cases and 35,447 controls of European ancestry) from the meta-analyzed Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium and Epidemiology of Endometrial Cancer Consortium data, excluding UK Biobank participants; (iv) Pulit and colleagues (21) on female-specific BMI, which includes 434,794 women of European ancestry from the GIANT consortium and UK Biobank.
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the Olink Explore 3072 platform in 52,363 UK Biobank participants, the exact sample size and platform of one row. The sentence calls the subcohort European ancestry, where the dictionary row is multi-ancestry, predominantly European.
